notes:
### New Features

- Add an Adult-TV-Channels.com-only Player Test alongside the existing Site and IPTV One Channel checks.
- Discover Penthouse-reference player/HLS family candidates from the saved COM playlist and COM Site listing, then store the recognized channel group locally for future test runs without repeated detection.
- Test each recognized channel for a fixed internal 90 seconds after successful playback startup, collecting per-channel player/video/cache observations.

### Improvements

- Offer Run Player Test for saved groups and Detect Players Again + Run to refresh recognition on demand.
- Use the existing IPTV path for saved PVR channels and the COM Site playback path for website-only channels.
- Hide the time selector and Sleep/Shutdown actions in Player Test mode; always finish with Save Log Only.
- Save Player Test sessions to a separate named log so previous One Channel Check logs are not overwritten.

### Bugfixes

- Keep the new Player Test separate from the existing timed One Channel Check, including its power-action and cancellation paths.
- Do not reuse stale signed media URLs or tokens in the persisted player-group fingerprints.

### Important

- First run needs live channel recognition. Similar embed/HLS fingerprints are only probable or strong family matches, not proof that streams share the same backend or reliability.
- A 90-second check can catch startup problems but cannot rule out five-minute source windows or long-duration stalls; test a representative sender for longer before applying changes to a whole group.
- Dorcel's 5-second live delay, existing screenshot/recovery behavior, IPTV conditional list refresh, native extension dialogs and unrelated providers remain unchanged.
- Live player recognition and playback on LibreELEC have not yet been validated; v1.166 is the direct rollback if needed.
